newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in quiet activity.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mixed on Wednesday, supported by reseller buying but pressured by sluggish feedmixer demand, dealers said.
"It's all been jobber (reseller) oriented," one dealer said, referring to the recent buying in the market.

"The jobbers are buying, that is why we are up so much," a Minnesota dealer said. "We are getting delays from the feedmixers and I am kind of wondering how long this will last. They don't need it so they are delaying feed shipments."
"There is no demand. I can't seem to get anything going with the mills," a Carolinas dealer said.
Also, Kansas City midds remained tight in the nearbys due to snow cover, a Kansas City trader said.
